design_overview: CareSlot is a calm, trustworthy mobile-first hospital booking app. Patients register, find doctors, book, reschedule or cancel, and track reminders in under two minutes. Staff get a role-based console for doctors, availability, walk-in bookings and delivery status.

screens.name: Welcome and Sign In
screens.purpose: Let patients register, verify email, log in and reset a forgotten password.

key_components.name: Brand Header
key_components.styling: Subtle teal gradient with rounded bottom corners, white 'CareSlot' wordmark and tagline 'Book care in minutes'.
key_components.interaction: Static; no action.

key_components.name: Auth Mode Tabs
key_components.styling: Pill segmented control with 'Sign In' and 'Register'; the active tab is solid teal with white text.
key_components.interaction: Switches the form between sign-in and registration fields.

key_components.name: Full Name Input
key_components.styling: 56px rounded input with a light border and placeholder 'Full name'. Shown in Register mode only.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type; inline validation on blur.

key_components.name: Email Input
key_components.styling: Rounded white input with teal focus ring and placeholder 'Email address'.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type; shows an error message if the format is invalid.

key_components.name: Phone Input
key_components.styling: Rounded input with country code prefix and placeholder 'Mobile number for SMS reminders'. Register mode only.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type digits; used for SMS reminders.

key_components.name: Password Input
key_components.styling: Rounded masked input with placeholder 'Password (8+ characters)' and a show/hide text toggle.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type; the toggle reveals the password.

key_components.name: Forgot Password Link
key_components.styling: Right-aligned teal text link 'Forgot password?'.
key_components.interaction: Opens the Reset Password sheet.

key_components.name: Primary Auth Button
key_components.styling: Full-width 56px teal gradient button, white bold label 'Sign In' (becomes 'Create Account' in Register mode).
key_components.interaction: Sign In opens Find a Doctor; Register opens the verification modal.

key_components.name: Verify Email Modal
key_components.styling: White rounded sheet with a teal check badge, 'Check your email' and a primary 'Open Sign In' button.
key_components.interaction: Confirms the verification email was sent; button returns to Sign In.

key_components.name: Reset Password Sheet
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet with an email input 'Registered email' and a primary 'Send Reset Link' button.
key_components.interaction: Sends the reset link and shows a success toast.

screens.user_flow: App launch opens here. Successful sign-in leads to Find a Doctor. Registration shows the verification modal, then Sign In.

screens.name: Find a Doctor
screens.purpose: Search doctors by name, specialty or department and see who has open slots.

key_components.name: Greeting Header
key_components.styling: Teal gradient header with 'Hello, Sarah' and a white bell icon with a red unread dot.
key_components.interaction: Bell opens Notifications.

key_components.name: Search Input
key_components.styling: Floating white rounded search bar with shadow and placeholder 'Search doctor, specialty or department'.
key_components.interaction: Typing filters the doctor list live.

key_components.name: Specialty Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scroll of pill chips: 'All', 'Cardiology', 'Dermatology', 'Pediatrics', 'Orthopedics'. The selected chip is teal.
key_components.interaction: Tap a chip to list only matching doctors with open slots.

key_components.name: Filter Button
key_components.styling: 48px square outlined button beside the search bar with a filter icon.
key_components.interaction: Opens a filter sheet for date, department and gender.

key_components.name: Next Appointment Card
key_components.styling: Light blue card: 'Next visit: Dr. Chen, Tue 10:30 AM' with a small 'View' link.
key_components.interaction: Opens My Appointments.

key_components.name: Doctor Result Card
key_components.styling: White rounded card with a circular photo, name, specialty, star rating, fee and green badge 'Next: Today 2:30 PM'.
key_components.interaction: Opens Doctor Profile and Booking.

key_components.name: Favorite Button
key_components.styling: Round 40px icon button at the top-right of each doctor card, outlined heart.
key_components.interaction: Toggles saving the doctor to favorites.

key_components.name: Empty Results State
key_components.styling: Centered text 'No doctors with open slots' and an outlined 'Clear Filters' button.
key_components.interaction: Clear Filters resets the chips and search.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with top border: Home (active teal), Appointments, Notifications, Staff Console (staff only).
key_components.interaction: Tap a tab to switch screens.

screens.user_flow: Reached after sign-in or from the Home tab. Tapping a doctor opens Doctor Profile and Booking. The bell opens Notifications.

screens.name: Doctor Profile and Booking
screens.purpose: View a doctor's availability, pick a slot and confirm a booking that no one else can take.

key_components.name: Back Header
key_components.styling: Transparent top bar with a back arrow, title 'Book Appointment' and a share icon.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Find a Doctor; share sends the profile link.

key_components.name: Doctor Profile Card
key_components.styling: White card with a large circular photo, 'Dr. Emily Chen', 'Cardiologist, 12 yrs', rating and a saved heart.
key_components.interaction: Heart toggles favorite.

key_components.name: Date Selector
key_components.styling: Horizontal strip of rounded day tiles (Mon 12, Tue 13). The selected tile is teal; days without slots are greyed.
key_components.interaction: Tap a day to reload that day's slots.

key_components.name: Time Slot Grid
key_components.styling: Three-column grid of 44px outlined pills like '09:30 AM'. Selected is teal and filled; booked slots are grey with strikethrough.
key_components.interaction: Tap an open slot to select it; booked slots are disabled.

key_components.name: Visit Reason Input
key_components.styling: Multi-line rounded input with placeholder 'Reason for visit (optional)'.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type notes for the doctor.

key_components.name: Booking Summary Strip
key_components.styling: Light blue strip: 'Tue, Mar 13 at 09:30 AM, Consultation $60'.
key_components.interaction: Updates live as the date and slot change.

key_components.name: Confirm Booking Button
key_components.styling: Sticky full-width teal gradient button 'Confirm Booking'; disabled grey until a slot is chosen.
key_components.interaction: Reserves the slot and opens the confirmation modal.

key_components.name: Booking Confirmed Modal
key_components.styling: Rounded sheet with a green check, 'Booking Confirmed', an email/SMS sent note and a 'View My Appointments' button.
key_components.interaction: Opens My Appointments.

key_components.name: Slot Conflict Toast
key_components.styling: Red-tinted toast: 'That slot was just taken. Pick another time.' with a 'Refresh' action.
key_components.interaction: Refresh reloads the slots; the toast auto-dismisses after 5 seconds.

screens.user_flow: Opened from a doctor card or from Reschedule. Confirm leads to the confirmation modal, then My Appointments. Back returns to search.

screens.name: My Appointments
screens.purpose: Let patients view, reschedule or cancel appointments, with the 24-hour cancellation rule enforced.

key_components.name: Screen Header
key_components.styling: Clean white header with the bold title 'My Appointments' and a teal 'Book New' icon button.
key_components.interaction: Plus opens Find a Doctor.

key_components.name: Status Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented pills: 'Upcoming', 'Past', 'Cancelled'. The active tab is teal with white text.
key_components.interaction: Switches the list between the three statuses.

key_components.name: Appointment Card
key_components.styling: White card with doctor photo, 'Dr. Emily Chen', 'Tue, Mar 13, 09:30 AM', and a green 'Confirmed' chip.
key_components.interaction: Opens appointment details.

key_components.name: Reminder Status Chip
key_components.styling: Small outlined chip on each card: 'Reminder: SMS in 24h' with a bell icon.
key_components.interaction: Tap to open Notifications settings.

key_components.name: Reschedule Button
key_components.styling: Outlined teal button 'Reschedule' with an edit icon, on the left of the card actions.
key_components.interaction: Opens Doctor Profile and Booking with the same doctor.

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.styling: Text button 'Cancel' in red with a trash icon; disabled with 'Less than 24h' when too late.
key_components.interaction: Opens the cancel confirmation modal.

key_components.name: Cancel Confirmation Modal
key_components.styling: Rounded dialog 'Cancel this appointment?' with a policy note, a red 'Yes, Cancel' button and a 'Keep Appointment' link.
key_components.interaction: Yes releases the slot, sends confirmation and shows a toast.

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered text 'No upcoming appointments' with a primary 'Find a Doctor' button.
key_components.interaction: Opens Find a Doctor.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with Appointments active in teal; other tabs grey.
key_components.interaction: Tap a tab to switch screens.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Appointments tab or after booking. Reschedule opens Doctor Profile and Booking. Cancel returns to this list with a success toast.

screens.name: Notifications and Reminders
screens.purpose: Show patient confirmations and reminders, manage channels, and let receptionists track delivery status.

key_components.name: Screen Header
key_components.styling: White header with the title 'Notifications' and a settings icon on the right.
key_components.interaction: Scrolls to the reminder preferences card.

key_components.name: View Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented control 'Inbox' and 'Delivery Status'. Delivery Status is visible to receptionists only.
key_components.interaction: Switches between patient inbox and staff delivery log.

key_components.name: Notification Item
key_components.styling: Rows with a teal bell badge, bold 'Reminder: Dr. Chen tomorrow 9:30 AM', a timestamp and an unread dot.
key_components.interaction: Opens the related appointment in My Appointments.

key_components.name: Confirmation Item
key_components.styling: Row with a green accent: 'Booking confirmed' or 'Appointment rescheduled' and a small email/SMS label.
key_components.interaction: Opens the appointment details.

key_components.name: Reminder Preferences Card
key_components.styling: White card titled 'Reminder channels' with two toggles, 'Email' and 'SMS', both teal when on.
key_components.interaction: Toggles update how reminders are delivered.

key_components.name: Delivery Search Input
key_components.styling: Rounded input with placeholder 'Search patient or appointment'. Delivery Status tab only.
key_components.interaction: Filters the delivery log as you type.

key_components.name: Delivery Status Row
key_components.styling: Row with patient name, appointment time, channel label and a status chip: green 'Delivered', amber 'Pending' or red 'Failed'.
key_components.interaction: Opens the delivery details.

key_components.name: Resend Button
key_components.styling: Small outlined teal button 'Resend' shown on failed rows.
key_components.interaction: Retries the notification and updates the status chip.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with Notifications active in teal.
key_components.interaction: Tap a tab to switch screens.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the bell icon or the Notifications tab. Tapping an item opens My Appointments. Receptionists use Delivery Status to resend failures.

screens.name: Staff Console
screens.purpose: Let admins manage doctors, doctors set weekly availability, and receptionists book for walk-in patients.

key_components.name: Console Header
key_components.styling: Teal gradient header 'Staff Console' with a role badge like 'Administrator' and a settings icon.
key_components.interaction: Settings opens the role and account options.

key_components.name: Console Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented pills: 'Doctors', 'Availability', 'Book for Patient'. The active tab is white on teal.
key_components.interaction: Switches the console section.

key_components.name: Report Stat Cards
key_components.styling: Three compact cards: 'Today 48 booked', 'Cancelled 6', 'No-shows 3'. Bold numbers with a small trend label.
key_components.interaction: Tap a card to open a detailed appointment report.

key_components.name: Doctor Management Row
key_components.styling: Row with a photo, name, department, an 'Active' toggle in green and an edit icon.
key_components.interaction: Toggle activates or deactivates the listing; edit opens the doctor form.

key_components.name: Add Doctor Button
key_components.styling: Floating teal pill button 'Add Doctor' with a plus icon and a soft shadow.
key_components.interaction: Opens the Add Doctor form sheet.

key_components.name: Add Doctor Form Sheet
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet with inputs 'Doctor name', 'Specialty', 'Department' and a primary 'Save Doctor' button.
key_components.interaction: Save adds the doctor to patient search results.

key_components.name: Weekly Availability Editor
key_components.styling: Card of Mon–Sun rows, each with an on/off switch and time range chips like '09:00 – 13:00', plus a 'Save Availability' button.
key_components.interaction: Save publishes new slots to the patient calendar within a minute.

key_components.name: Patient Lookup Input
key_components.styling: Rounded input with placeholder 'Search patient by name or phone', shown on the Book for Patient tab.
key_components.interaction: Shows matching patients; selecting one fills the booking form.

key_components.name: Book on Behalf Button
key_components.styling: Full-width teal gradient button 'Choose Doctor and Slot' under the selected patient card.
key_components.interaction: Opens Doctor Profile and Booking for the selected patient.

screens.user_flow: Visible only to staff roles via the Staff Console tab. Book on Behalf opens Doctor Profile and Booking. Saving a doctor returns to the Doctors list.

ui_components.name: Primary Button
ui_components.styling: 56px tall, full-width, 14px radius, subtle teal gradient, white semibold label, pressed state darkens.

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: 48px tall, white fill, 1.5px teal border and teal label, 12px radius.
ui_components.interaction: Triggers a supporting action such as Reschedule.

ui_components.name: Text Input
ui_components.styling: 56px, white fill, 1px slate border, 12px radius, teal focus ring, red border with helper text on error.
ui_components.interaction: Tap to type with inline validation.

ui_components.name: Doctor Card
ui_components.styling: White, 16px radius, soft shadow, circular photo, name, specialty, rating and availability badge.

ui_components.name: Time Slot Pill
ui_components.styling: 44px high outlined pill. Selected is filled teal; booked is grey with strikethrough.
ui_components.interaction: Tap to select an open slot.

ui_components.name: Status Chip
ui_components.styling: Rounded tinted pill with matching text: green Confirmed, amber Pending, red Failed or Cancelled.

ui_components.name: Segmented Tabs
ui_components.styling: Pill-shaped control on a light blue track; the active segment is solid teal with white text.

ui_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
ui_components.styling: 64px white bar with a top hairline; active tab has a teal icon and label, inactive tabs are slate.

ui_components.name: Confirmation Modal
ui_components.styling: White 20px-radius dialog over a dimmed overlay, with a title, short body and one primary plus one text action.
ui_components.interaction: Confirms or dismisses the pending action.

ui_components.name: Toggle Switch
ui_components.styling: 52x32px switch; teal when on, grey when off, with a white thumb.
ui_components.interaction: Tap to turn a setting on or off.

responsive_design: Mobile-first at 360px with single-column layouts. Tablet adds a two-column doctor grid. Desktop web centers content at a 480px column for booking and uses a wider table layout for the staff console. All touch targets stay at least 44px.
accessibility: Meets WCAG 2.1 AA: 4.5:1 text contrast, visible focus rings, labels on all inputs, screen-reader names on icon buttons, status shown by text as well as color, and a logical tab order. Text scales to 200% without breaking layouts.
animations: Subtle 200ms transitions: screen slide for navigation, bottom sheet slide-up for modals, tap scale to 0.97, slot selection fade-fill, skeleton loaders under 2s, and toast fade in and out.
icons: Outline icons only, 24px with a 2px stroke, limited to home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash and share. Teal for active, slate for inactive, red for destructive trash. No emojis.
